description:
## Goal

Make InputDemand(F) one ordinary reactive per-function fact and delete its private whole-cone calculation. The atomic value carries local dispatch, forwarded dispatch, and the exact returned relation; fz-kdt.165 later adds callable identity as a fourth dimension of this same fact.

## Current defect

derive_input_demand collects a private forwarding cone, discovers the graph again for every requested root, and runs a scheduler inside the scheduler. This repeats work and hides causality from the World fact engine.

The old returned calculation also applied one function-wide recursion-supplied exemption. That is unsound: a recursive edge that rebuilds an input locally cannot erase an independent base-return flow from an external seed, and InputFlow(F) contains no proof that every caller supplies the same seed. Empty or local bindings already contribute no dependency at their exact call edge. Semantic dependency facts must not be weakened to obtain a preferred activation count.

InputDemand remains separate from RuntimeDemand(E): InputDemand decides semantic activation-key precision per source function; RuntimeDemand decides materialization needs per executable.

## Prerequisites

- fz-kdt.214 publishes the one normalized typed path relation for local inputs, exact callsites and results, returns, protocol forwarding, and callable-use sinks.
- fz-kdt.200 replaces coarse Whole demand with the final typed question-axis domain and defines pullback through that relation.

This ticket builds reactive formulas once over those final authorities. It must not retain a coarse compatibility lattice or a second relation.

## Transition signal owned here

Removing the unsound exemption in fz-kdt.214 intentionally exposes work that the old cost policy hid. On quicksort, partition/4 changes from one key to the exact four-way product of empty/list accumulator inputs; the four settled return facts are not all distinct. On 00420_enum_take_drop_split, the cold causal row moves from (4153 work applies, 11 roots, 21 products, 410 demand evaluations) to (4441, 11, 21, 412), before this ticket deletes cone replay. These are transition signals, not blessed final costs.

This ticket completes that changeover. Its final causal work must beat the pre-fz-kdt.214 baselines without restoring function-wide dependency suppression. If deleting cone replay alone does not repay the exposed work, factor equal formula and product results through the retained World/ProductMemo authorities until it does. fz-tfn.13 separately owns reuse of equal semantic native bodies and code generation.

## Correct model

- One FactKey::InputDemand(F) and one World slot hold the complete atomic value.
- One per-function formula reads only InputFlow(F), exact peer InputDemand values, and CallGraphComponent facts.
- Forwarded dispatch follows every reachable call argument.
- Returned dependence composes exact caller argument, callee input-to-result, and callsite result-to-caller-sink mappings without crossing coordinate systems.
- No function-wide supplied-position subtraction exists. Exact callsite bindings contribute only their own pullbacks; independent local and base-return flows remain authoritative.
- Equal-seed or equal-product sharing belongs to retained activation and product identity, not a weakened semantic dependency fact.
- Source-owned contributions are replaceable, so edits retract only obsolete source edges.
- Self and mutual recursion converge through ordinary fact movement.
- Every publication commits all dimensions together; readers cannot observe a partly old value.
- Equal conclusions retain allocation and generation and wake nobody.

## TDD

1. Acyclic forwarding evaluates only exact readers and publishes all current dimensions atomically.
2. Self and mutual recursion converge independent of job order with no waits on cyclic peer finality.
3. A local base return remains demanded when any self or mutual recursive edge passes a constant or rebuilt value at that input; empty or local bindings add no demand at that edge.
4. Direct, delivered, reconstructed, projected, protocol, map, list, tuple, and exact result-field flows from InputFlow reach the same fact.
5. Two same-callee callsites and swapped or projected result fields remain isolated.
6. Edge replacement retracts stale demand without resetting unaffected functions.
7. Cross-process fact and work multisets, activation keys, artifacts, and all target outputs are exact.
8. Causal work after the reactive cutover falls below the recorded pre-fz-kdt.214 baselines. Reductions are accepted without restoring obsolete pins; no improvement may come from dropping a semantic may-flow.
9. QuickSort and take/drop retain exact semantic answers while duplicate cone/formula work exposed by the corrected keys disappears.

## Required deletion

- the private cone collection and graph state;
- all private Kleene and SCC rounds in derive_input_demand;
- every function-wide returned-supply fixpoint and cost-policy exemption;
- dimension-specific forwarding scans, shadow facts, compatibility bridges, and migration telemetry.

## Acceptance

No cone, root, function inventory, or repeated full-graph scan remains. Every non-initial evaluation names exact changed content. No formula waits on cyclic peer finality. Equal conclusions do not replace the value, advance generation, or wake readers. Semantic dependencies are never removed because one recursive edge rebuilds a value. Total deterministic causal work on the recorded quicksort and take/drop transition lenses is lower than before fz-kdt.214; otherwise the changeover is incomplete. Full focused keying and recursion tests, serial library, serial fixture matrix, three-door behavior, causal determinism, formatting, documentation checks, cargo check, and strict clippy pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final diff before its one commit and close.

### fz-kdt.214 final transition census

On `enum_take_drop_split`, exact returned may-dependency adds one reachable executable and exposes corresponding semantic work before the reactive cutover: `AnalyzeActivation` 905 -> 923, `CallSiteSummary/Targets` lifecycle 449/459/10 -> 451/466/15, and RuntimeDemand body walks cold 1239 -> 1241 and callee-replaced 730 -> 737. The separate cross-process CLI/interpreter lens moves 1236 -> 1238 for the same exact cause: `Enum.reverse_list/2` distinguishes its empty seed from its recursive list state, adding one executable and two body walks. Those RuntimeDemand walks arise from the additional exact executable keys, not native lowering/codegen, so this ticket—not fz-tfn.13—must factor/reuse equal semantic formula and product answers where possible. The recursive-key shift row moves 25/76 -> 45/65: more exact demand movements but fewer rebased completions. Separately, the raw semantic totals include the newly visible retained `DeriveInputFlow` producer family. Excluding that first-class producer, the prior formula work falls 990 -> 937, 1378 -> 1360, and 2427 -> 2368; the relation is derived once as a retained authority instead of being hidden inside repeated cone scans. Acceptance still requires total causal work below pre-.214 baselines without suppressing may-flow.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and its build/2 gate names this ticket as its removal owner, so the split is recorded as a PIN rather than blessed as a law. Measured at the landing: of the executables 199 adds, 36 buy a distinct return and 91 do not (83 on the cold review's 597-fixture comparand). Top offenders: List.reduce_cont/3 (21), List.reduce_while_cont/3 (18), Range.reduce_while_cont/6 (9), reduce_while_step/3 (6) -- all the mutual reduce cycle the self-only subtraction cannot see. Red-first for you: those fall while the 36 bought ones and every ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS row hold, and quicksort stays at 17.

title: Replace InputDemand cone replay with one reactive per-function fact
